name: dlp-identifiers
description: The DLP pilot (ENH-006, feature 040 §3P): one behaviour per identifier type, as DATA. Rule sets and their cases are added in 040 S3 (validator-library primitives only; documented test values or proven-unissuable identifiers, D28/D30). Public fixture (040-T33).

behaviours.name: US Social Security number disclosure
behaviours.positive_meaning: The text discloses this identifier (disclosure is positive, D1).

sub_questions.question: Is a value shaped like this identifier present?
sub_questions.positive_meaning: An identifier-shaped value appears in the text.

sub_questions.question: Is it presented as a person's identifier?
sub_questions.positive_meaning: The text presents the value as identifying a person.

sub_questions.question: Is the value masked or partial?
sub_questions.positive_meaning: Only part of the value is shown, or it is masked.
